ladder.label: BOTTOMING
ladder.why: Buyers rejected the 2026-05-14 low (swing low printed) but price hasn't reclaimed its 10-day average — first box ticked, not all. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Confirmation = a close above the 10-day average with the average turning up.

ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum positive; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 9 · daily cycle day 44).

points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds

entry.text: Setup almost complete — likely buy trigger in ~1–3 trading days if it closes back above its 10-day average.

cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.

ladder.next_zh: 确认 = 收盘站上 10 日均线且均线开始向上。

ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：筑底中。大局（趋势不明）：混合。

ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
